steps.npc: Welcome to the Mining Guild. My name's Gadrin and I'm the Guildmaster. Can I help you with anything?

options.text: What have you got in the guild?

steps.npc: All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
There's no better mining site anywhere!

options.text: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?

steps.player: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?

steps.npc: What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.

steps.player: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.

steps.npc: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?

options.text: What have you got in the guild?
Can you tell me about your skillcape?
options.condition: If the player does not have 99 Mining:

steps.player: Can you tell me about your skillcape?

steps.npc: Sure, this is a Skillcape of Mining. It shows my stature as a master miner! It has all sorts of uses including a skill boost to my Mining skill and a chance of mining extra ores. When you get to level 99 come and talk to
me and I'll sell you one.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

options.text: Can I buy a Skillcape of Mining from you?

steps.player: I believe I can buy a Skillcape of Mining from you?

steps.npc: You believe right, miner. You have earned the right to wear one and when you do you'll have a small chance of finding an extra ore, but I'll need 99000 coins from you first.
I'm sorry you feel that way; come back if you change your mind.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 99,000 coins:

steps.player: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.npc: Well, come back and see me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins and enough inventory space:
